title: EFC vs Stage-III Cosmology State Assessment
description: Stage-III weak-lensing recalibrations (KiDS Legacy; HSC Y3 with DESI clustering-z) move S8 upward and reduce prior LSS–CMB growth tension to sub-1σ. This methodology/validation update repositions Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) from a tension-resolution narrative to a precision structural competitor, introduces the Structural Coherence Evaluation (SCE) protocol distinguishing O-layer vs M-layer quantities, and notes that the BAO-locked background coupling β = 0.08 yields σ8 ≈ 0.805, consistent with the converging Stage-III landscape.

S8_definition.description: Amplitude combination constrained by weak-lensing two-point statistics; used as the baseline growth comparison across Stage-III analyses.

lensing_response.description: EFC’s scale- and redshift-dependent mapping between matter fluctuations and lensing (matter-to-lensing response). In GR/\LambdaCDM, \Sigma=1; deviations provide a structural diagnostic.

sigma8_from_beta.description: EFC background prediction for the present-day fluctuation amplitude when the coupling \beta is fixed by BAO distances; matches converging Stage-III central values without post-hoc tuning.

gr_recovery_high_z.description: EFC recovers GR at high redshift in its lensing response, serving as a falsifiable mapping-level expectation.

key_results.main_finding: Stage-III recalibrations bring weak-lensing S8 into close agreement with CMB-inferred growth, and EFC’s BAO-locked background coupling (β = 0.08) predicts σ8 ≈ 0.805 consistent with KiDS Legacy and recalibrated HSC Y3, shifting EFC’s focus to testing structured deviations via Σ(k,z).
parameters_tested: High-z GR recovery in lensing response
datasets_used: KiDS Legacy cosmic shear (Wright et al. 2025)
HSC Year 3 with DESI clustering-redshift calibration (Choppin de Janvry et al. 2025)
BAO distances (BOSS DR12) for β locking

sealed_predictions.statement: With β fixed by BAO-only distances, EFC predicts a present-day amplitude σ8 ≈ 0.805; future WL and CMB-lensing meta-analyses that control calibration systematics should remain statistically consistent with this value.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A joint WL + CMB-lensing analysis (with validated n(z) and image simulations) yielding σ8 that is >3σ away from 0.805, sustained across independent pipelines.

sealed_predictions.statement: EFC’s mapping-level lensing response recovers GR at high redshift (Σ(k,z) → 1), while allowing structured, scale-dependent deviations on smaller, non-linear scales at low redshift.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-z (z ≳ 1) WL/RSD/CMB-lensing cross-checks showing robust, repeated evidence for non-GR lensing response (Σ ≠ 1) at high z, or conversely low-z small-scale WL data that decisively prefer Σ=1 with no room for EFC-like structure once modeling is controlled.

kill_criteria: KC1: A combined CMB-lensing analysis delivers σ8 that deviates from the EFC β-locked prediction (≈0.805) by more than 3σ, replicated across independent pipelines and systematics treatments.

KC2: After final calibration (validated n(z), image simulations, baryon modeling), O-layer shear two-point data across multiple surveys are better fit by GR/ΛCDM with Σ=1 than by any EFC variant, with Δχ² ≤ 0 for EFC and AIC/BIC decisively favoring ΛCDM in locked-vs-free Σ model selection.
KC3: Updated BAO distance analyses exclude the β value that underpins EFC’s background (β ≈ 0.08) at >3σ while ΛCDM remains consistent, removing the background-channel basis for EFC.
KC4: High-redshift (z ≳ 1) growth and lensing datasets consistently detect non-GR lensing/dynamical behavior incompatible with EFC’s GR-recovery regime, sustained across surveys and analyses.

observation_level_test.equation: Clκiκj = ∫ dχ [Wi(χ) Wj(χ) / χ²] · Σ²(k,z) · Pδ(k,z)
observation_level_test.falsification_criterion: Additional mapping freedom must be statistically justified at O-layer (ΔAIC, ΔBIC)

strengths_in_new_landscape: β = 0.08 → σ8 = 0.805 matches converging data without tuning
Growth suppression via Hubble friction (correct mechanism, correct direction)
One transition function T(z) governs all regimes (no patches)
Built-in predictions for scale-dependent and environment-dependent effects
Five pre-registered falsification criteria, none triggered
challenges_in_new_landscape: Reduced motivation from S8 tension (the 'problem' is smaller)
Σ channel needs re-validation against updated baselines
Must demonstrate second-order predictions are testable with current/upcoming data
Self-consistent EFC background (not ΛCDM-calibrated) still needed

stage_III_update_footnote: Since submission, the Stage-III weak-lensing landscape has shifted upward: KiDS Legacy reports S8 = 0.815 (+0.016/−0.021) (Wright et al. 2025), and HSC Y3 recalibrated with DESI clustering-redshifts yields S8 = 0.805 ± 0.018 (Choppin de Janvry et al. 2025). The EFC background-coupling prediction (σ8 ≈ 0.805) is consistent with these updated values. The S8 tension motivation discussed in this work should be read in light of this convergence; the structural predictions and falsification criteria remain unchanged.
